sentences.en: Lori Balton is a location scout in L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛里·巴尔顿是洛杉矶的一名外景制片人。

sentences.en: She's worked on Inception, Heat, A River Runs Through It, a whole lot of movies.
sentences.zh: 她参与过《盗梦空间》、《盗火线》、《大河恋》等许多电影的制作。

sentences.en: She was the first ever location professional ever asked to join the Academy.
sentences.zh: 她是史上第一位受邀加入电影艺术与科学学院的外景专业人士。

sentences.en: You're not the only one.

sentences.en: On location with Lori is producer Avery Truffleman.
sentences.zh: 与洛里一起在外景地的是制片人艾弗里·特鲁夫曼。

sentences.en: Lori's job is to find interesting, plot-conducive locations.
sentences.zh: 洛里的工作是寻找有趣且利于剧情发展的拍摄地点。

sentences.en: Lots of them.

sentences.en: I frequently will show someone over a hundred different options for one location,

sentences.en: you know, before they get a sense of what they want.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在他们真正明白自己想要什么之前。

sentences.en: But scouts also have to make sure that the locations they find are actually usable.
sentences.zh: 但外景制片人还必须确保他们找到的地点确实可用。

sentences.en: So a big part of Lori's job is convincing property owners to say yes,
sentences.zh: 所以洛里工作的一大部分是说服业主点头同意，

sentences.en: a part which she is really, really good at.
sentences.zh: 而这一部分她真的非常、非常擅长。

sentences.zh: 你有各个不同楼层的阳台，

sentences.en: and create a whole range of different moods for various genres.
sentences.zh: 恐怖片可能更多是仰拍、俯拍，

sentences.zh: 他们必须带进来太多的“玩具”，

sentences.en: They just have to get in so many toys,

sentences.zh: 这出奇地重要，因为电影拍摄涉及货车、

sentences.en: It's also nice that the Bradbury is close to downtown

sentences.en: and the crew can just go grab lunch.
sentences.zh: 我们非常、非常庆幸它还在这里。

sentences.en: It is, there's like nothing like it in Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 那是建筑历史学家金·库珀。

sentences.en: and we're so, so glad it's still here.
sentences.zh: 她带我回到了布拉德伯里大厦，

sentences.en: That's Kim Cooper, architectural historian.
sentences.zh: 还有她的丈夫理查德·谢夫。

sentences.en: She brought me back to the Bradbury,
sentences.zh: 我们是Esoteric的创始人，这是一家巴士旅游公司，

sentences.en: along with her husband, Richard Shave.
sentences.zh: 提供洛杉矶的游览服务，

sentences.en: We are founders of Esoteric, which is a bus tour company
sentences.zh: 专注于建筑、真实犯罪和文学。

sentences.en: that gives tours of Los Angeles,
sentences.zh: 这三个元素在布拉德伯里大厦汇聚在一起。

sentences.en: focusing on architecture, true crime, and literature.
sentences.zh: 布拉德伯里大厦于1893年开放，

sentences.en: Three elements which all come to a head in the Bradbury building.
sentences.zh: 远在电影来到洛杉矶之前。

sentences.en: The Bradbury opened in 1893,
sentences.zh: 顺便说明一下，它不是以科幻小说家雷·布拉德伯里命名的。

sentences.en: way before the movies ever came to L.A.
sentences.zh: 它是以金矿百万富翁路易斯·布拉德伯里的名字命名的。

sentences.en: And for the record, it's not named after the sci-fi novelist Ray Bradbury.
sentences.zh: 在19世纪90年代中期，布拉德伯里先生决定建造一座大楼，

sentences.en: It's named for Louis Bradbury, a gold mining millionaire.
sentences.zh: 并以他的名字命名，因为他是一位建设这座城市的重要人物。

sentences.en: In the mid-1890s, Mr. Bradbury decided he was going to build a building
sentences.zh: 于是在1892年，布拉德伯里委托这位大名鼎鼎的建筑师，

sentences.en: with his name on it because he was an important man that built up the city.
sentences.zh: 萨姆纳·亨特，来设计他的大楼。

sentences.en: So in 1892, Bradbury commissions this big-deal famous architect,
sentences.zh: 但布拉德伯里不喜欢亨特展示给他的任何方案。

sentences.en: Sumner Hunt, to design his building.
sentences.zh: 布拉德伯里很失望，转身离开亨特的办公室。

sentences.en: But Bradbury didn't like any of the plans that Hunt showed him.
sentences.zh: 但是，当他走出去时，出于某种原因，

sentences.en: Bradbury, disappointed, turns to leave Hunt's office.
sentences.zh: 他的目光被亨特的一名绘图员吸引住了，

sentences.en: But, as he goes out, for some reason,
sentences.zh: 这个年轻人叫乔治·怀曼。

sentences.en: his eye is caught by one of Hunt's draftsmen,
sentences.zh: 他才29岁，还没有受过专业的建筑师培训。

sentences.en: this young guy named George Wyman.
sentences.zh: 没人知道为什么，但是……

sentences.en: He's 2930, he has no professional training yet as an architect.
sentences.zh: 布拉德伯里拉住怀曼，拽了拽他的袖子，说道，

sentences.en: And no one knows why, but...
sentences.zh: 我有一个提议要给你。

sentences.en: Bradbury takes Wyman, pulls his sleeve, and says,
sentences.zh: 嗯，那个提议完全是不可能且不恰当的。

sentences.en: I have an offer to make to you.
sentences.zh: 他想雇佣这个孩子，一个非建筑师，来建造这座非常重要的、价值五十万美元的办公大楼。

sentences.en: Well, that offer is completely impossible and inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 而这个年轻人，乔治·怀曼，感到有点不安，这是可以理解的，

sentences.en: He wants to hire this kid, who isn't an architect, to build this very important half-million-dollar office building.
sentences.zh: 因为他完全没有资格胜任这份工作。

sentences.en: And this young guy, George Wyman, is a bit weirded out, understandably,
sentences.zh: 而且他不想让别人觉得他在抢老板的生意。

sentences.en: because he is totally unqualified for this job.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这个机会太不可思议了。

sentences.en: And he didn't want it to seem like he was taking business away from his boss.
sentences.zh: 这是一个无法抗拒的提议，但乔治·怀曼是一个有道德的人，而且他也害怕得要命。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, this opportunity was incredible.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，这个机会实在太棒了。

sentences.en: It's an irresistible offer, but George Wyman is an ethical man, and he's also scared to death.
sentences.zh: 这确实是个无法抗拒的提议，但乔治·怀曼是个有道德的人，而且他也被吓坏了。

sentences.en: And so he does what any good Angelina will do in the very late 19th century,
sentences.zh: 于是，他做了任何一个19世纪末的安吉利诺人都会做的事，

sentences.en: which is he will consult dead relatives.
sentences.zh: 那就是去咨询已故的亲人。

sentences.en: Spiritualism was huge at this time.
sentences.zh: 当时唯灵论非常盛行。

sentences.en: And George Wyman thought that his deceased brother, Mark,
sentences.zh: 乔治·怀曼认为他已故的兄弟马克，

sentences.en: might have some wisdom to offer from the afterlife.
sentences.zh: 或许能从阴间提供一些智慧。

sentences.en: So Wyman sits down with a planchette, a precursor to a Ouija board,
sentences.zh: 于是怀曼坐下来，拿出一个占卜板，也就是通灵板的前身，

sentences.en: which wrote out sentences with a pencil when you rested your hands on it.
sentences.zh: 当你把手放在上面时，它会用铅笔写出句子。

sentences.en: Planchettes would typically be consulted when someone had an issue that they wanted some guidance on.
sentences.zh: 人们通常在遇到想要寻求指引的问题时，会去咨询占卜板。

sentences.en: So he and his wife were sitting together saying,
sentences.zh: 所以他和妻子坐在一起，心想：

sentences.en: what on earth should I do about Mr. Bradbury's wonderful, terrifying offer?
sentences.zh: 对于布拉德伯里先生那个美妙又可怕的提议，我到底该怎么办？

sentences.en: The planchette, overcome with the spirit of Wyman's dead brother, began to move.
sentences.zh: 占卜板在怀曼已故兄弟灵魂的驱使下开始移动。

sentences.en: And it wrote, take Bradbury, in a very childish script hand, you will be blah, blah, blah, blah.
sentences.zh: 它用一种非常幼稚的笔迹写道：接受布拉德伯里，你会……巴拉巴拉。

sentences.en: Just this nonsense script.
sentences.zh: 就是这种毫无意义的文字。

sentences.en: And Wyman and his wife were like, what?
sentences.zh: 怀曼和妻子当时就懵了，心想这是什么？

sentences.en: And it was when one of the two of them walked around the other side of the table and read it upside down,
sentences.zh: 直到他们其中一人走到桌子对面，倒过来读，

sentences.en: this Palmer-type script actually said, successful.
sentences.zh: 才发现这种帕尔默式的笔迹写的是：成功。

sentences.en: Take Bradbury, you will be successful.
sentences.zh: 接受布拉德伯里，你会成功的。

sentences.en: That was a clear enough message for Wyman.
sentences.zh: 这对怀曼来说是一个足够明确的信息。

sentences.en: He says yes to Bradbury.
sentences.zh: 他答应了布拉德伯里的提议。

sentences.en: The design of the Bradbury was directly inspired by a novel,
sentences.zh: 布拉德伯里大厦的设计直接灵感来源于一部小说，

sentences.en: Looking Backwards by Edward Bellamy, which was written in 1887.
sentences.zh: 即爱德华·贝拉米于1887年创作的《回顾》。

sentences.en: But in it, there is a description of a building in the year 2000.
sentences.zh: 书中对2000年的一座建筑有详细描述。

sentences.en: The future!
sentences.zh: 未来！

sentences.en: What Wyman was trying to do with this building, I think we can answer just simply by reading the passage.
sentences.zh: 怀曼想通过这座建筑实现什么，我想我们只需读读这段文字就能找到答案。

sentences.en: A vast hall full of light, received not alone from the windows on all sides, but from the dome.
sentences.zh: 一个充满光亮的大厅，不仅来自四周的窗户，还来自穹顶。

sentences.en: So that's what this building does.
sentences.zh: 这就是这座建筑的作用。

sentences.en: And that's why, even though the Bradbury is quite old by California standards, it feels current.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么尽管布拉德伯里大厦以加州的标准来看已经很老了，但它依然感觉很现代。

sentences.en: It was designed for the year 2000.
sentences.zh: 它是为2000年而设计的。

sentences.en: It's this blend of styles that makes it an architectural gem.
sentences.zh: 正是这种风格的融合使其成为建筑瑰宝。

sentences.en: But aside from the occasional film shoot, the building spent a lot of its life totally ignored.
sentences.zh: 但除了偶尔的电影拍摄外，这座建筑在很长一段时间里都被完全忽视了。

sentences.en: This building, by late 40s, early 50s, is once described as a chicken coop.
sentences.zh: 到40年代末、50年代初，这座建筑曾被形容为鸡舍。

sentences.en: And that just refers to the dustiness and the sort of untidiness.
sentences.zh: 这指的仅仅是它的灰尘和那种杂乱无章的状态。

sentences.en: By 74, this place has really fallen apart.
sentences.zh: 到了74年，这个地方已经破败不堪了。

sentences.en: So when Ridley Scott shot Blade Runner in its central atrium, it wasn't actually that hard to make it look so shabby.
sentences.zh: 所以当雷德利·斯科特在其中庭拍摄《银翼杀手》时，要让它看起来那么破旧其实并不难。

sentences.en: Oh, Blade Runner.
sentences.zh: 哦，《银翼杀手》。

sentences.en: That was just amazing.
sentences.zh: 那真是太棒了。

sentences.en: That was before we'd actually fixed it up.
sentences.zh: 那是在我们修缮它之前。

sentences.en: And you can tell that from the movie.
sentences.zh: 从电影里就能看出来。

sentences.en: This is Adele Yellen.
sentences.zh: 这是阿黛尔·耶伦。

sentences.en: I no longer own the building, but my husband bought the building in the late 80s and he retrofitted it.
sentences.zh: 我不再拥有这座建筑了，但我丈夫在80年代末买下了它，并进行了翻新。

sentences.en: Adele's late husband, Ira Yellen, spearheaded L.A.'s downtown revival by restoring old historic buildings and turning them into housing and businesses.
sentences.zh: 阿黛尔已故的丈夫艾拉·耶伦通过修复历史建筑并将其改造成住宅和商业空间，引领了洛杉矶市中心的复兴。

sentences.en: But the Bradbury was just a jewel and he wanted to work on it and he felt if you build it, they will come.
sentences.zh: 但布拉德伯里大厦是一颗明珠，他想对其进行改造，他坚信只要你建造它，人们就会来。

sentences.en: So, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以，我不知道。

sentences.en: They ultimately came, but he did have to use the city to help him.
sentences.zh: 他们最终确实来了，但他确实不得不寻求市政府的帮助。

sentences.en: Ira Yellen asked if the city of Los Angeles could find a steady tenant for the Bradbury.
sentences.zh: 艾拉·耶伦询问洛杉矶市政府能否为布拉德伯里大厦找到一个稳定的租户。

sentences.en: He ended up getting the police department.
sentences.zh: 他最终争取到了警察局。

sentences.en: Most of the office space in the Bradbury building belongs to the Internal Affairs Division of the LAPD.
sentences.zh: 布拉德伯里大厦的大部分办公空间都属于洛杉矶警察局的内务部。

sentences.en: They're there all the time and they don't mind the filming generally.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都在那里，通常也不介意拍摄活动。

sentences.en: That's Eric Bender.
sentences.zh: 那是埃里克·本德。

sentences.en: He now handles all the filming requests for the Bradbury.
sentences.zh: 他现在负责处理布拉德伯里大厦所有的拍摄请求。

sentences.en: When we do a police drama, we take extra precaution to make sure they know that we're filming and the person running around with a gun type of thing is not someone.
sentences.zh: 当我们拍摄警匪剧时，我们会采取额外的预防措施，确保他们知道我们在拍摄，那个拿着枪跑来跑去的人不是真的警察。

sentences.en: I get very concerned about that.
sentences.zh: 我对此非常担心。

sentences.en: But filming isn't the priority for the property anymore.
sentences.zh: 但拍摄不再是该物业的首要任务了。

sentences.en: Since its renovation, the tenants' needs come firSt.
sentences.zh: 自翻新以来，租户的需求被放在了第一位。

sentences.en: We try not to bother the tenants too much, so we try to do the filming or not do more than one or two filming projects per month.
sentences.zh: 我们尽量不去打扰租户，所以我们尽量控制拍摄，每月不超过一两个项目。

sentences.en: And generally, this is the case throughout buildings downtown.
sentences.zh: 通常市中心的建筑都是这种情况。

sentences.en: Now that people live and work there, they don't want production crews periodically taking over.
sentences.zh: 现在人们在那里生活和工作，他们不希望摄制组定期接管这里。

sentences.en: These days, film crews can't blow up cars in the street or have 300 zombies stampede down Broadway in the middle of the workday.
sentences.zh: 如今，摄制组不能在街上炸毁汽车，也不能在工作日让300个僵尸在百老汇大街上横冲直撞。

sentences.en: The downtown revival is a part of why filming is leaving Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 市中心的复兴是电影拍摄离开洛杉矶的部分原因。

sentences.en: It left.
sentences.zh: 它离开了。

sentences.en: I mean, there's no feature film shooting here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这里已经没有故事片在拍摄了。

sentences.en: It's scary because, as I said, I love living here and I would like to continue sleeping in my bed if possible.
sentences.zh: 这很可怕，因为正如我所说，我喜欢住在这里，如果可能的话，我想继续睡在自己的床上。

sentences.en: Location scout Lori Bolton just spent almost a year scouting and shooting in Atlanta, Georgia, which might just become the new Hollywood.
sentences.zh: 外景勘察员洛里·博尔顿刚在佐治亚州亚特兰大花了近一年时间勘景和拍摄，那里可能正成为新的好莱坞。

sentences.en: Because I've spent so much time in Atlanta, it's like I'll look at a movie and go, oh yeah, that's Atlanta.
sentences.zh: 因为我在亚特兰大待了太久，看电影时我会说，哦，那是亚特兰大。

sentences.en: You can't fool me.
sentences.zh: 你骗不了我。

sentences.en: Atlanta, like a lot of other cities in the South, Midwest, and Canada, is offering major incentives to encourage filming.
sentences.zh: 亚特兰大，像南部、中西部和加拿大的许多其他城市一样，正在提供重大激励措施来鼓励拍摄。

sentences.en: These tax breaks can save producers millions of dollars.
sentences.zh: 这些税收减免可以为制片人节省数百万美元。

sentences.en: I don't understand how these places are not going broke, giving the incentives that they are.
sentences.zh: 我不明白这些地方提供这样的激励措施怎么还没破产。

sentences.en: Cities like Atlanta are also developing state-of-the-art studios and attracting good production talent.
sentences.zh: 像亚特兰大这样的城市也在开发最先进的摄影棚，并吸引优秀的制作人才。

sentences.en: We really need to do everything we can to keep filming in L.A.
sentences.zh: 我们真的需要尽一切努力把拍摄留在洛杉矶。

sentences.en: Which would mean making the public more open to the disruptive film shoots and keeping the costs of permits down and adding new tax incentives and to stop developing so rapidly.
sentences.zh: 这意味着要让公众对扰民的拍摄更加包容，保持许可费用低廉，增加新的税收激励措施，并停止如此迅速的开发。

sentences.en: What's happening in L.A.
sentences.zh: 洛杉矶正在发生的事情是，

sentences.en: is we're losing a lot of our parking lots.
sentences.zh: 我们正在失去大量的停车场。

sentences.en: They're tearing them down and putting buildings up.
sentences.zh: 他们拆掉停车场，盖起大楼。

sentences.en: It's so funny to hear people bemoan the loss of parking lots.
sentences.zh: 听到人们哀叹停车场的消失真是太有趣了。

sentences.en: Not people.
sentences.zh: 不是普通人。

sentences.en: Location people.
sentences.zh: 是外景勘察人员。

sentences.en: There's a difference.
sentences.zh: 这不一样。

sentences.en: We're kind of a weird breed.
sentences.zh: 我们算是一个奇怪的群体。

sentences.en: But however state-of-the-art studios in Atlanta, Toronto, or Chicago are becoming, there are elements of Los Angeles that cannot be replicated, even on the finest soundstage.
sentences.zh: 但无论亚特兰大、多伦多或芝加哥的摄影棚变得多么先进，洛杉矶都有一些元素是即使在最好的摄影棚里也无法复制的。

sentences.en: Like the experience of entering the Bradbury Building.
sentences.zh: 比如走进布拉德伯里大厦的体验。

sentences.en: It's a place so unique, so remarkable, that after it was built, the draftsman, George Wyman, decided to take some classes and actually become an architect.
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此独特、如此非凡的地方，以至于在它建成后，绘图员乔治·怀曼决定去上课，并真正成为了一名建筑师。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible was produced this week by Avery Truffleman, with Katie Mingle, Sam Greenspan, and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 本周的《99%隐形》由艾弗里·特鲁夫曼制作，凯蒂·明格、萨姆·格林斯潘和我，罗曼·马斯共同参与。

sentences.en: Special thanks this week to Linda Dishman, head of the L.A.
sentences.zh: 本周特别感谢洛杉矶保护协会负责人琳达·迪什曼。

sentences.en: Conservancy.
sentences.zh: 我们是旧金山KALW 91.7地方公共广播电台的一个项目，在美丽的加州奥克兰市中心的ArcSign建筑与室内设计公司办公室制作。

sentences.en: We are a project of 91.7, local public radio, KALW, San Francisco, and produced out of the offices of ArcSign, an architecture and interiors firm in beautiful downtown Oakland,
sentences.zh: 加利福尼亚州。

sentences.en: California.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注这个节目。

sentences.en: You can find this show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都在Twitter、Instagram和Spotify上。

sentences.en: All of us are on Twitter, Instagram, and Spotify.
sentences.zh: 但要了解更多关于这个故事的信息，包括精美的图片和链接，并收听《99%隐形》的所有剧集，你必须访问99pi.org。

sentences.en: But to find out more about this story, including cool pictures and links, and listen to all the episodes of 99% Invisible, you must go to 99pi.org.
